$comment: Shared HAXcms API message codes. Both backends add `code` and `params` next to the English `message` they already send; front ends and the CLI translate by code using locales/haxcms-api.<lang>.json and fall back to the English message. Source of truth: @haxtheweb/haxcms-elements/lib/haxcms-api-codes.json. Each `match` is a regular expression for the whole message, case-insensitive; named groups become params. Entries are tried in order. Messages on successful (2xx) responses only get a code when the entry has kind "info".
